assets.name: Glass heart and seedling
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium photorealistic 3D editorial hero artwork for erik, a Kazakhstan volunteering and community platform. A single elegant sculptural heart made from two broad interlocking curved ribbons of translucent deep forest-green optical glass, one softly frosted sage-green ribbon and one clear emerald ribbon. The ribbons curve towards and gently embrace each other to form a recognizable open heart silhouette, symbolizing people coming together to help. At the lower inner curve, a tiny living green seedling with two leaves adds a natural human warmth. Beautiful physically accurate glass refractions, subtle edge highlights, soft realistic contact shadows. This should feel like a sophisticated commissioned design object photographed by a premium product photographer, not a toy or a cartoon. Off-white seamless studio background #f7f8f4 with faint warm sunlight from upper left. Composition: wide landscape 3:2, the sculpture occupies the right 65 percent, left third is empty matching off-white for website copy. Entire sculpture in frame with generous space, grounded, slightly three-quarter view, no pedestal. Muted green palette, restrained silver reflections, tactile material and immaculate soft lighting. No words, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no interface, no people, no extra objects. High detail.

assets.name: Volunteers planting a sapling
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide editorial photograph for a minimalist volunteering website, paired with an emerald glass heart hero. A beautifully composed candid close-up of three adult volunteers working together to plant a young leafy sapling in dark rich soil in a sunlit community garden in Kazakhstan. Focus on the action and cooperation: two pairs of natural anatomically accurate hands in subtly worn cream gardening gloves and one pair of bare hands gently support the root ball. Cropped torsos only, no faces, muted sage and off-white cotton sleeves. The sapling has a graceful slender stem and beautiful small green leaves. Authentic, quiet and hopeful rather than staged charity stock photography. Soft late-afternoon side lighting, delicate film grain, subtle shallow depth of field, premium editorial photography. Landscape 3:2 composition with action occupying central and right two thirds, softly blurred cream and pale sage foliage behind, natural earthy greens, warm neutral skin tones, not oversaturated. No text, logos, watermarks, graphic overlays, illustration or 3D effect. Beautiful real textures, natural hands, no extra fingers.
